plan_review.notes: Adopted bounded reach-aware wounded orbit at 30% reach clamped 10-14ft instead of uncapped half reach; retained healthy 6ft orbit. Pressure entry uses max(rangedSafeDistance, defensiveOrbit+approachBuffer), release uses the explicit RANGED_DEFENSIVE_RELEASE_MULTIPLIER=2, limiting bow release to about 32.4ft. Added explicit RETREAT-time/transition oracle and a multi-enemy multi-poll no-snapback regression.
